answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the falcon index resolves every citation against the pigment checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the quill audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1412 identities would post 2331 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
